ModMetaData.name: N.E.K.O RimWorld Bridge (Dev)
ModMetaData.author: N.E.K.O Team
ModMetaData.description: Read-only development bridge between RimWorld and N.E.K.O. This build provides an authenticated loopback protocol, save/load session identity, and a bounded colony-digest query. It does not execute gameplay actions or automate the colony.
